mapper.update: UPDATE phone_verifications SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND attempt_count < 5 AND verified_at IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL
UPDATE phone_verifications SET verified_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW() AND attempt_count < 5
UPDATE phone_verifications SET used_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW()
